name: Fujiwara no Kintō
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 55); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 1041.

poems.title: This waterfall’s melodious voice
poems.author: Fujiwara no Kintō
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 55
poems.text:
This waterfall’s melodious voice
Was famed both far and near;
Although it long has ceased to flow,
Yet still with memory’s ear
Its gentle splash I hear.
